description: Fresh complete campaign matrices on final gameplay commit 55b8b5b with passive save validation. Every initial, monthly and final snapshot is encoded, decoded and compared with its compacted serialized state; the live state and RNG must stay identical. Checkpoints sample command boundaries and do not establish every intermediate state or arbitrary future continuation. Concurrent runs provide no performance measurement and adjacent-bot results do not replace human acceptance.

assembly.note: 24 independent cases; original full-matrix seed indices, complete case coverage, immutable source, external harness and configuration verified. Parallel runtime totals are not performance measurements.
